description: A lightweight toolkit of building blocks for Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in C#. It provides interfaces and base classes for value objects, entities, aggregate roots, domain events, repositories and the unit of work, with no dependency on any persistence technology.
releaseNotes:
Version 1.0.0.

First stable release. The changes below are relative to 0.2.0.

- Clarifies unit-of-work disposal and retry rules, provides .NET Framework-compatible infrastructure examples, and documents the C# 12 requirement for the examples.
- Finalizes the public API baseline and runs tests with the release version before publishing.
- Adds Under(name, index) to compose zero-based collection element paths such as Lines[2].Quantity. Negative indices throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException. This is an additive API change; the existing Under(name) overload remains supported.
- Adds the abstract DomainEvent(DateTimeOffset OccurredAt) record implementing IDomainEvent. EventId defaults to a new Guid and can be initialized with a stored identifier when restoring an event. OccurredAt is still supplied by the caller. This is an additive API change; existing IDomainEvent implementations remain supported.
- DomainValidationException messages now include the paths and type names of the first 10 validation errors in input order, followed by the number of remaining errors. Errors with an empty path are listed by type name alone; error property values are not included. The Errors property still retains every error. Public API signatures are unchanged.
- Adds AggregateNotFoundException and GetAsync, an extension method of IRepository<TAggregate, TId>, to CSStack.DDD.Application. GetAsync throws AggregateNotFoundException if the aggregate does not exist, so that use cases do not each throw their own exception and the upper layers can turn a missing aggregate into HTTP 404 in one place. FindAsync still returns null, for callers to which a missing aggregate is a normal result.
- Breaking change: replaces OutOfRange<T> with BelowMinimum(decimal Minimum, decimal Actual) and AboveMaximum(decimal Maximum, decimal Actual). The new errors are not generic, so they can be matched and serialized without knowing a type argument, and a rule with only one bound can be represented. Use them for numbers; TooLong and TooShort remain for length. For other kinds of values, such as dates, define your own error.
- Breaking change: AggregateRoot<TSelf, TId> now implements PullDomainEvents() explicitly, so it can be called only through IDomainEventSource. If application services or domain code pulled the events, they would be cleared and not written to the outbox on commit. DomainEvents remains public for checking the recorded events, for example in tests.
- Breaking change: IAggregateRoot<TSelf, TId>, IRepository<TAggregate, TId> and IDeletableRepository<TAggregate, TId> now require the aggregate to be a class. A struct would be copied on every assignment and lose the events recorded on the copy, and the null returned by FindAsync had no meaning for a struct. Aggregates that derive from AggregateRoot<TSelf, TId> are not affected.
- The assembly is now strong-named (public key token 9f050175924426b8), so that strong-named .NET Framework assemblies can reference it. The assembly version now contains only the major version (0.0.0.0 while the version is 0.x), so .NET Framework applications need no binding redirects when they update within a major version. The file version and the informational version keep the full version.

Documentation: https://github.com/Uta-member/CSStack.DDD/tree/master/docs/en
